tests.student_result: inclusive m_jj spectrum, 2016G+H JetHT, AK4 CHS, |deta|<1.1, rebuilt from skims (incl. golden JSON, trigger OR)
tests.level: shape: detector-level counts (student) vs CMS observed event yields (detector level, wide jets); both normalised in the common range
tests.statistic_name: two-sample Pearson chi2 (stat. errors only)
tests.reason: Shape differs by a mass-dependent slope; CMS uses wide jets (FSR recombination, mjj shifted up), |deta|<1.3 vs 1.1, |eta|<2.5 vs 2.4; a mass-scale factor s absorbs the slope (see mass_scale_fit). Statistical errors only.

tests.student_result: inclusive dsigma/dm = N/(L dm), same data and selection as D5 (|deta|<1.1), L = 16.39 fb^-1
tests.level: absolute: student detector-level N/(L dm) vs CMS cross section (pb/TeV, L = 35.9 fb^-1 recovered from the table); CMS uses |deta|<1.3 and wide jets
tests.statistic_name: n.a. (ratio far outside any plausible systematic envelope)
tests.reason: Ratio 0.505 (|deta|<1.1 vs 1.3); 0.650 after correcting the |deta| acceptance with the student's own data; flat in m_jj (slope -0.0019 +- 0.0018 /TeV) and uniform in run, so not a mass-scale/wide-jet effect (a pure mass-scale fit needs s = 1.083 and then leaves deviance 846 for 35 bins). Cause not identified.

tests.student_result: peak positions and core widths of J/psi, psi(2S), Upsilon(1S,2S,3S), Z from fits to histograms.pkl (unchanged)
tests.level: exact (constants): fitted detector-level peak positions vs PDG masses; no momentum corrections applied
tests.statistic_name: largest |mass offset| in per mille
tests.reason: Formal test against the PDG masses with stat + fit-systematic uncertainties. All offsets are negative (-0.7 to -2.2 per mille), Upsilon(1S), (2S) deviate by >3 sigma formally; the size is that of an uncorrected tracker momentum scale (typical size of muon momentum-scale corrections, ~0.1-0.2 %, not re-measured here), not a physics disagreement.

details.expected: scale offsets of order 1 per mille (up to a few) and sigma/m of 1-1.5 % without muon momentum corrections; CMS-SMP-17-010: pT resolution 1% barrel, <3% endcaps (20-100 GeV)

auxiliary.student_result: G+H fraction of the full 2016 luminosity
auxiliary.reason: EXO-20-008 2016 spectra use 36.3 fb^-1 (all of 2016, eras B-H); the student uses G+H only (0.452 of it). Only cross sections (N/L) can be compared, not counts.

auxiliary.student_result: normalisation of the 2016 tables of ins1920627
auxiliary.reason: The 2016 tables carry LUMINOSITY=138 fb^-1 but N/(dsigma/dm * width) = 36.3 fb^-1 (the 2016 luminosity quoted in Fig. 3 of the paper): the qualifier is the Run 2 total, not the normalisation.

auxiliary.student_result: per-jet DeepJet Medium efficiency for true b jets in Z' MC
auxiliary.level: text values ~75/45/10 % at jet pT 0.2/1/3 TeV vs student eff_M
auxiliary.reason: Quoted in the paper text only, at fixed jet pT; the student quotes per Z' mass (jet pT ~0.4 M, broad). Indicative only.

auxiliary.student_result: events per recorded fb^-1 vs run (diagnostic)
auxiliary.reason: uniform rate per fb^-1 across runs -> flat factor is not a lost-run or prescale effect

auxiliary.student_result: dimuon mass shape vs SMP-17-001 Table 3 (full phase space, FSR-corrected)
auxiliary.reason: Table 3 is acceptance-corrected to the full phase space and FSR-corrected (dressed leptons); the student data are fiducial detector-level with no acceptance/FSR correction. Needs the acceptance and FSR response from simulation (not available here).
